title: Contact lens fitting
what: The doctor checks your eyes and fits lenses of the right size and strength. You learn how to put them in, take them out, and care for them.
why: When you want to see without glasses, for sports, or on your doctor's advice.
duration: usually 40 to 60 minutes; sometimes a follow-up check is needed a few days later
tell_doctor: If you wore lenses before and had problems
Dry eyes, allergies, frequent eye infections
How you will wear them: every day or sometimes
What medicines and eye drops you use

prepare.title: If you already wear lenses
prepare.text: Ask the clinic whether to come with your lenses in or out.

prepare.title: Nails
prepare.text: Short nails make it easier to put lenses in.

prepare.title: Time
prepare.text: Do not come in a rush. Learning takes time.

bring: Your old lenses or their box
steps: The surface of your eye is measured and examined
After a while, the doctor checks how they sit
You learn to put lenses in and take them out yourself
You are told about care, wearing time, and when to replace them
feel: For the first minutes, you can feel the lens in your eye
Watery eyes the first time is normal
after: Wash your hands every time before touching your lenses
Do not sleep or swim in lenses unless your doctor allows it
Replace lenses and solution on time
Come for checkups when your doctor says
red_flags: Redness, pain, light sensitivity, or worse vision: take the lenses out and see an eye doctor urgently

faq.q: Can I sleep in my lenses?
faq.a: Usually not. Only special lenses, and only if your doctor allows it.

faq.q: Can I rinse lenses with water?
Contacts or glasses: which is better?
faq.a: It depends on your eyes and lifestyle. Your doctor will help you choose.

reminders.text: Contact lens fitting in 2 hours. Bring your glasses and your old lens box.
